events.title: Victim enters station
events.description: Platform 9 camera captures victim at 21:14. Last confirmed sighting.

events.title: Anonymous tip received
events.description: Switchboard logs anonymous call referencing Platform 9 disturbance.

events.title: Ticket stub recovered
events.description: Torn ticket stub found in inner coat pocket during initial sweep.

events.title: Ticket ledger mismatch
events.description: Morning audit reveals ledger discrepancy — three entries lack counterfoils.

events.title: Night clerk second visitor
events.description: CCTV corroborates clerk testimony: unidentified visitor at 01:15.

events.title: Clerk reports break-in attempt
events.description: Night clerk dials emergency line reporting forced entry at Annex B.

events.title: Suspect A detained
events.description: Individual matching description apprehended near loading dock.

events.title: Evidence room entry log
events.description: Critical evidence room shows unauthorized access at 04:47.

events.title: Partial print from Annex B
events.description: Latent print recovered from forced door handle. Partial match pending.

events.title: Cross-reference initiated
events.description: Analyst begins cross-referencing ledger anomalies with CCTV timestamps.

events.title: Suspect B identified
events.description: Second suspect identified through partial print match. Warrant issued.

events.title: Informant tip — Canal St.
events.description: Registered informant provides location intel on Suspect B.

events.title: Suspect B apprehended
events.description: Suspect B taken into custody at Canal Street Market without incident.

events.title: Accelerant trace confirmed
events.description: Lab confirms petroleum-based accelerant on loading dock samples.

events.title: Archive cage breach evidence
events.description: Cut lock recovered; tool marks consistent with compact bolt cutter.

events.title: Pattern link established
events.description: Analyst connects three incidents to single MO. Crime spree hypothesis elevated.

events.title: DNA sample submitted
events.description: Biological sample from ticket stub sent for expedited DNA analysis.

events.title: Cross-case link promoted
events.description: Three-case connection promoted from hypothesis to active lead.

facts.text: The victim entered the station at 21:14 and never appeared on the northbound camera.
A torn ticket stub was recovered from the inner coat pocket.
The night clerk claims a second visitor arrived fifteen minutes after closing.
The ledger clock differs from station time by seven minutes.

investigations.name: Mumbai 26/11 Attacks
investigations.summary: A coordinated attack across multiple locations in Mumbai between 26 and 29 November 2008.
investigations.historicalNote: Historical reconstruction based on court and government records. Approximate times are marked ≈.

locations.title: NARIMAN POINT WATERFRONT
locations.description: General Nariman Point waterfront movement marker for Team 05. It is not presented as an exact landing coordinate.

locations.title: BADHWAR PARK
locations.expandedName: Badhwar Park / Machhimar Nagar, Cuffe Parade
locations.description: Documented landing area used by the attack group on the evening of 26 November 2008.

locations.title: CST
locations.description: The Supreme Court judgment records 52 people killed and 109 injured at CST.

locations.title: CAMA HOSPITAL
locations.description: The court record separates the incident into CAMA_IN and CAMA_OUT phases.

locations.title: LEOPOLD CAFÉ
locations.description: The Supreme Court judgment records 11 people killed and 28 injured at Leopold Café.
locations.assignedTeam: NAZIR AHMAD @ ABU OMAIR + SHOAIB @ ABU SOHEB

locations.title: TAJ MAHAL PALACE
locations.description: The Supreme Court judgment records 36 people killed and 30 injured at the Taj.
locations.assignedTeam: ABDUL RAHMAN ‘BADA’ @ HAJAZI + JAVED @ ABU ALI; NAZIR AHMAD @ ABU OMAIR + SHOAIB @ ABU SOHEB AFTER LEOPOLD

locations.title: NARIMAN HOUSE
locations.description: The Supreme Court judgment records 9 people killed and 7 injured at Nariman House.
locations.assignedTeam: IMRAN BABAR @ ABU AQSA + NASIR @ ABU UMAR

locations.title: OBEROI / TRIDENT
locations.description: The Supreme Court judgment records 35 people killed and 24 injured at the Oberoi / Trident.

locations.title: GIRGAUM CHOWPATTY

locations.title: WADI BUNDER / MAZGAON
locations.description: Secondary incident recorded in the Wadi Bunder Road / Mazgaon area. Marker is at the verified Wadi Bunder locality.

locations.title: VILE PARLE EAST

locations.title: KUBER / PRE-ATTACK MARITIME CASE
locations.description: Included in the verified casualty ledger. No map coordinate is asserted for this record.

events.title: Attack group reaches the Mumbai shore

events.title: Nariman House incident underway
events.description: A witness in the Supreme Court record encountered an attacker inside Nariman House at about 21:45.

events.title: Leopold Café incident
events.description: The two attackers subsequently moved to the Taj Mahal Palace.

events.title: Taj Mahal Palace incident underway
events.description: The incident at the Taj was underway during the late evening of 26 November.

events.title: Oberoi / Trident incident begins
events.description: The Supreme Court judgment records entry at about 21:55.

events.title: CST incident underway
events.description: A witness in the court record heard the first major explosion at approximately 21:55.

events.title: Kasab and Abu Ismail reach the Cama Hospital area
events.description: Documented movement after leaving CST.

events.title: Mazgaon / Wadi Bunder secondary incident
events.description: Secondary incident recorded in the Wadi Bunder Road / Mazgaon area.

events.title: Vile Parle East secondary incident

events.title: Kasab and Abu Ismail emerge from the Cama Hospital area
events.description: Documented movement from the Cama Hospital area.

events.title: Vehicle taken near Nariman Point / Vidhan Sabha area
events.description: The Supreme Court judgment records the sequence at approximately 00:15.

events.title: Police interception at Girgaum Chowpatty
events.description: Ajmal Amir Kasab was captured alive and Abu Ismail was killed during the documented police interception.

events.title: Nariman House operation concludes

events.title: Taj Mahal Palace operation concludes
events.description: The final clearance at the Taj marks the end of the attack period in this case reconstruction.

facts.text: The attack group reached the Mumbai shoreline at Badhwar Park between approximately 21:15 and 21:30 on 26 November 2008.
facts.sourceTitle: Supreme Court of India judgment / 29 Aug 2012

facts.text: CCTV and witness evidence documented the CST incident; the judgment records 52 people killed and 109 injured there.
facts.sourceTitle: Supreme Court of India judgment / 29 Aug 2012

facts.text: The Oberoi / Trident incident began at approximately 21:55 on 26 November 2008.
facts.sourceTitle: Supreme Court of India judgment / 29 Aug 2012

facts.text: The Supreme Court judgment records 166 people killed and 238 injured across the attack.
facts.sourceTitle: Supreme Court of India judgment / 29 Aug 2012

facts.text: David Coleman Headley pleaded guilty in the United States to charges connected with planning the Mumbai attacks and conducted pre-attack surveillance of potential targets during multiple visits.
facts.sourceTitle: U.S. Department of Justice / Headley sentencing record

facts.text: The Supreme Court judgment records 36 people killed and 30 injured at the Taj Mahal Palace.
facts.sourceTitle: Supreme Court of India judgment / 29 Aug 2012

facts.text: The Cama record is separated into CAMA_IN (7 killed, 10 injured) and CAMA_OUT (9 killed, 7 injured).
facts.sourceTitle: Supreme Court of India judgment / 29 Aug 2012

facts.text: The documented clearance sequence concludes at the Oberoi / Trident on 28 November, Nariman House during the night of 28 November, and the Taj at approximately 09:00 on 29 November.
